searchText: If I remember correctly, somebody mentioned on yesterday's ACDE call that there are already Hive tests for EIP-7516. But I cannot find anything. Does anybody know where they are? I believe it could be this branch from `execution-spec-tests` - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/294, once its merged we will have a new release soon after, and then these tests will be ran within the `pyspec` simulator on hive Thank you Btw! you also need this geth branch to fill them https://github.com/marioevz/go-ethereum/tree/cancun-t8n-blob-gas-opcode Then you can use: ``` fill --until=Cancun ``` And the opcode is used throughout the eip4844 tests 👍 <@755913785620824175> could you change "Cancun+1153" to simply "Cancun" in execution-spec-tests

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Btw! you also need this geth branch to fill them
https://github.com/marioevz/go-ethereum/tree/cancun-t8n-blob-gas-opcode
Then you can use:
```
fill --until=Cancun
```
And the opcode is used throughout the eip4844 tests 👍
